title: The host galaxies of radio-loud quasars at z > 5 with ALMA
question: How do the cool gas ([CII]) and dust properties, morphology, kinematics, companions and synchrotron contribution of z>5 radio-loud quasar host galaxies compare with radio-quiet quasar hosts, and is there a signature of radio-jet interaction?

recipe.method: Extract spectrum in circular aperture centred on the quasar; aperture radius set where flux in concentric apertures (0.1'' to 3.0'') plateaus; fit flat continuum plus Gaussian line
key_parameters: Aperture radii listed per source in the 1D table (1.3-2.3'')
assumptions: Sources may be extended, so a source-centred aperture is used

recipe.goal: Build continuum-subtracted [CII] cubes and moment-0 maps; measure line flux with 2D Gaussian
recipe.method: Choose line window at Gaussian-fit peak +/-1.4 sigma, uvcontsub in uv space, re-image with tclean (robust=2), moment-0 maps, 2D Gaussian fit in CASA, correct flux by ~1.20
key_parameters: Line window = Gaussian-fit peak +/-1.4 sigma (~83% of line flux)

recipe.method: Make pure continuum maps for lower and upper sidebands by collapsing line-free channels and fit a 2D Gaussian in CASA; Band 3 gives no detection
key_parameters: Flux at 1900 GHz rest frame used for IR quantities

recipe.goal: Derive CO(6-5) and continuum upper limits for Band 3 sources
recipe.method: Extract 1D spectrum from the central pixel; continuum 2 sigma upper limit from mean rms of the spectrum; line flux 3 sigma upper limit with 300 km/s width; then luminosity and FIR/TIR limits via the same formulae
key_parameters: Line width 300 km/s; 3 sigma line limit; 2 sigma continuum limit
assumptions: Typical line width 300 km/s from literature

recipe.goal: Estimate redshifts from [CII] and velocity offsets of UV lines
recipe.method: Redshift from [CII] peak; compare to literature Mg II, Lya and template redshifts as velocity offsets

recipe.goal: Build radio-to-sub-mm SEDs and estimate synchrotron contribution at ~300 GHz
recipe.method: Combine literature radio data and new RACS/FLASH fluxes (Gaussian fit in CASA to CASDA images) with ALMA continuum; model radio with power law (broken for PSO352-15; post-turnover slope for GPS/HFP sources); extrapolate to ALMA frequency and subtract to get a second dust-only estimate
key_parameters: Indicative slope alpha=-0.67 for PSO055-00 and PSO135+16
J2228+0110 radio slope alpha=-0.39 +/- 0.17 between 323 MHz and 1 GHz
assumptions: Non-simultaneous radio data; variability may alter SED shape; power law extrapolation assumed (may bend downward)

recipe.goal: Derive L_CII, dust mass, L_FIR/L_TIR, SFRs, [CII] EW
recipe.method: L_CII from line flux (Carilli & Walter relation); optically thin modified black body scaled to 1900 GHz continuum with CMB correction; integrate for L_FIR (42.5-122.5 um) and L_TIR (8-1000 um); SFR_CII from De Looze 2014; SFR_IR from Kennicutt & Evans 2012
key_parameters: L_FIR = 0.75 L_TIR for the adopted model
assumptions: Optically thin dust; fixed T_dust and beta from literature

recipe.goal: Estimate dynamical and molecular gas masses
recipe.method: Dispersion-dominated M_dyn from [CII] size (major axis of 2D Gaussian) and FWHM with inclination 46 deg; M_H2 from L_CII with alpha_CII=30 Msun/Lsun
assumptions: Unresolved system, dispersion dominated (sigma = 0.75 FWHM); inclination from literature median

recipe.goal: Compare RL and RQ quasar hosts (distributions, KS test, [CII] deficit, UV luminosity)
recipe.method: Re-derive quantities consistently for literature RQ (76) and RL sources; compare L_CII, EW, FWHM, SFR distributions with Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests; plot L_CII/L_FIR vs L_FIR and vs M1450

Run findclumps on continuum-subtracted cubes with floating-average channel windows of 3-19 channels; merge entries closer than 2''; fidelity from negative/positive detections pooled across fields; require fidelity>0.9, SNR>4, within +/-1000 km/s, away from field edge; compare with RQ-field and blank-field expectations
assumptions: Positive emission = real sources + noise; negative emission = noise only
